faqs.q: What is a 400 V AC to 24 V DC converter package with a NEMA 4X enclosure used for?
faqs.a: The package powers DC control circuits from a 400 V AC mains supply, giving 24 V DC at 1 kW continuous duty. It comes in a NEMA 4X enclosure with the converter, input breaker, output connections, status LEDs and surge protection; see the [AC/DC converters shelf](/c/ic-acdc-converters).

faqs.q: Which input voltages and outputs can the 1 kW AC/DC converter package be built for?
faqs.a: Besides 400 V AC input, the listing names 230, 380, 415, 440 and 460 V AC inputs with 12 or 24 V DC output. Output power options are 250 W, 500 W, 1 kW and 2 kW, so state the supply and load when you ask.

faqs.q: What power does the 400 V AC to 24 V DC package deliver?
faqs.a: This listing is the 1 kW continuous-duty version delivering 24 V DC. Other output powers of 250 W, 500 W and 2 kW are listed as variants.

faqs.q: What is inside the NEMA 4X enclosure of the converter package?
faqs.a: The enclosure contains the converter, an input breaker, the output power-supply connections, status LEDs and surge protection. This lets the unit be installed as one protected assembly.

faqs.q: What is a NEMA 4X enclosure, and why use one on a converter package?
faqs.a: A NEMA 4X enclosure is rated for wet and corrosive outdoor-type locations; the listing uses it to house the converter in field conditions. State the site conditions and we confirm the enclosure fits.

faqs.q: Is there a hazardous-area version of the AC/DC converter package?
faqs.a: Yes, the listing says a hazardous-area Ex-d variant is available. Tell us the zone and certification you need and we confirm what is offered.

faqs.q: What does the 24 V DC output of the converter package supply?
faqs.a: It supplies DC control circuits such as sensors, data acquisition and instrumentation on a unit, from a 400 V AC mains supply. See the [data acquisition systems](/c/ic-data-acquisition) and the [pressure sensors](/c/ic-electronic-pressure-sensors) that run on 24 V DC.

faqs.q: How is the AC/DC converter package installed and protected?
faqs.a: The package includes an input breaker and surge protection, so connect the 400 V AC supply to the breaker and take 24 V DC from the output connections. Status LEDs show the state of the unit.

faqs.q: What do I need to tell Indus to quote the the 400 V AC to 24 V DC converter package?
faqs.a: Quote the full title, AC/DC Converter Package, 400 V AC → 24 V DC, NEMA 4X Enclosure, 1 kW, with the variant, size or voltage you need, and say where it will be used and which standard or zone applies. We confirm the specification and lead time on the quotation; start on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Where is an AC/DC converter package used?
faqs.a: It suits oilfield skids and control cabinets where mains power is available and instruments need 24 V DC; see the [oilfield instrumentation guide](/blog/oilfield-pressure-and-flow-instrumentation) for the instrumentation it feeds.

faqs.q: Where is the AC/DC converter package supplied from?
faqs.a: We supply the package from Dubai, UAE and ship it worldwide. Tell us the input voltage and output power so it is built to the right specification.

faqs.q: Is the 400 V AC to 24 V DC converter package in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, we hold the 400 V AC to 24 V DC converter package in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).
